liveVerification.deviationDeclared: Dispatch step 5 asked to generate both reports live via the HTTP brief endpoint. POST /property-explorer/v1/research/brief is gated requirePeAuthenticated + requirePePaidOrPropertyUnlocked (session auth, paid/unlocked entitlement) -- creating a real paid/unlocked session in production is out of scope for a per-parcel-read, structurally-read-only card and was not authorized. Instead verified the exact shipped modules directly: loadParcelRecordFloodFact() (parcelRecordFactRead.ts, the new SELECT-only reader) and buildR1Brief() (r1BriefCompose.ts, the existing compose function my change extends) were invoked in-process against live production FACTORY_DATABASE_URL (SELECT-only credential, no writes attempted, no writes possible per memoryParcelRecordFlood's own falsifier test) for all three test parcels. This exercises the entire changed code path -- read module plus compose/translation layer -- against real prod data and real prod code (same commit as deployed); it does not exercise the pre-existing, unchanged HTTP auth/entitlement layer, which is out of scope for this card and already covered by existing CI (SS-W18 api-server boots).
